system.description:
A hot headed, blond shinobi stands at the beginning of the starting line. Other shinobi approach the starting line nervous that the blond shinobi is here at all. A start sound erupts as the adjacent shinobi all begin to race each other. The blond dashes forward with relative ease as he accelerates faster and faster. They cross the finish line. As everyone sits around tired and exhausted. He says “Good effort guys. Too bad I won twice already.” One of the other shinobi question what he means. To which he explains, the moment the race started he blinked passed the finish line, and caught back up with the other racers so they didn’t give up and so he could see who would come in second place, unfortunately he also came in second place.

—Shuria Nata

At Worlds End, Ch. 1 excerpt.

Faster than the eye can see

The Namikaze Clan is a clan that doesn’t know its origins, but it’s assumed they hail from the land of Fire. Their most prominent member became its 4th Hokage. The Namikaze Clan doesn’t have a powerful family name, nor does it share a family compound or hold any high-ranking title. It is embodied by its ideal of speed and potential. The Namikaze clan has produced some of the fasted shinobi in the leaf, and the continuation of this tradition will move further into future.

Namikaze Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 Int

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Chakra Control.

Swift Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Lightning Release affinity. (Pick one)

Swift Release Techniques: The Namikaze Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Namikaze Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Namikaze Features

Blood of the Swift

1st Level Clan Feature

The Namikaze are known for their incredible reflexes and agility. Due to your natural gift for speed, you develop a special fuinjutsu meant to seal bursts of chakra within you, that you can release for exponential boosts to your physicality. This special fuinjutsu is known as Speed Seals and are represented as D8’s. You have a number of Speed Seals equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend Speed Seals on any feature or ability that calls for it. You regain spent seals when you finish a rest of any type. The first of such abilities you can spend Speed Seals on are your Blitz Arts, special abilities passed down from clansmen to clansmen. You begin with 2 such abilities. You gain an additional one at 7th and 15th levels.

Flash Dodge

As a reaction to taking damage, you can spend up to 2 Speed Seals, gaining +2 bonus to AC, until the beginning of your next turn, for each die spent. This bonus to AC is also applied against the triggering attack.

Flash Step

At the beginning of your turn, by spending 1 Speed Seal you gain the benefits of the Dash action. You also cannot have your speed reduced as a result of hostile effects for the duration.

Speed Amplification

At the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Speed Seal. When you do, you gain a +10-bonus speed and ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. This increases to +20 at 7th level and +30 at 15th level.

Blitz Assault

Once per turn, as part of making an attack when you cast a jutsu, you can spend 2 Speed Seals to make one additional attack of the same type, dealing 2d8 damage on a hit and reapplying the jutsu’s non-damaging effect on a success, if any. This damage increases to 4d8 at 7th, and 6d8 at 15th level.

Blink of an Eye

At the beginning of your turn, by spending 2 Speed Seals, you can select a space within your movement speed range and teleport to the chosen location. All hostile creatures whose space is adjacent to the space you teleport to must make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering a -2 penalty to their AC until the beginning of your next turn on a failed save due to the suddenness of your appearance. If you were to make an attack against a creature with a penalized AC during the same turn you teleport, you can choose to spend 1 additional Speed Seal to teleport back to the original space you started your turn in.

Phase Dodge

As a reaction to making a Strength or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Speed Seals. When you do, you make a Dexterity saving throw in place of the triggering save.

Like the Wind

Once per turn, when you deal wind or lightning damage to a creature, you can spend 1 Speed Seal, and select a different creature within 30 feet of you, and teleport into a space adjacent to them, and make one unarmed or weapon attack against them, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage], plus your spent Speed Seal.

Rushing Start

When you roll initiative, you can spend 1 Speed Seal, adding twice the result to your initiative.

Speed Burst

Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend 3 Speed Seals to gain an additional Action. This additional action lasts until the end of the current turn. Once you use this blitz art, increase the Speed Seal cost of this blitz art by +1, until you complete a long rest.

Speed Formula

As a bonus action, you can mark one weapon you are wielding with your Speed Seal. This mark lasts for the next hour or until spent. Marking a weapon doesn’t spend it.

As a bonus action on following turns, you can spend the marked weapons Speed Seal, teleporting to it, so long as its within 120 feet of you and is not destroyed/broken.

Interdiction Seal

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Namikaze are related to the Uzumaki through both blood and familial history. The Namikaze honors that by training its members to be specialist in Fuinjutsu as well as speed. Once per turn, when you deal damage with a weapon attack or a melee attack, you can spend 1 Speed Seal to mark a damaged creature with the spent seal. A specialized seal of your design grows over the impact point and there it remains for the next minute. While a creature is marked in this way, the seal provides the following benefits to you:

Marked. Trigger Interdiction Seal effects from Hijutsu you cast.

Triangulate. The first attack each turn against a marked creature has a +1 to the attacks critical threat range.

Interdiction. As a reaction, to a marked creature you can see casting a jutsu that requires Hand Signs (HS), you can detonate the Speed Seal forcing their chakra network to go out of control. The affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, having their jutsu Interrupted gaining 1 rank of Sealed on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level. Once your speed seal has detonated, the creature is no longer marked.

| #### Speed Sovereign / Reflex Amp / Your movements leaves steaks the same color as your hair. You leave after images in your wake. Others can barely comprehend what you have become. / Seal Reproduction. You regain 1 Speed Seal at the beginning of each of your turns for the duration. / Chain Blink. You can teleport to any creature marked with your Speed Seal, once per turn. If there are multiple creatures marked with your Speed Seal, you can teleport to them each, once per turn. / Spatial Sovereign. The Sealed condition cannot prevent you from teleporting. / Spatial Immunity. You cannot be teleported against your will by any means. |

Swift Release Manifestation

7th Level Clan Feature

The Namikaze clan has a unique talent for manifesting Swift Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Lightning Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Swift Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Lightning respectively.

Additionally, once per turn, at the beginning or end of that turn, you can spend 1 Speed Seal to teleport to a creature or object marked with your Speed Seal, so long as they are within 120 feet of you.

Tricksters Blink

11th Level Clan Feature

Your speed and reflexes have reached their peak. You are now where attacks go to be embarrassed. You gain the following special abilities you can use once per turn.

Redirecting Flashpoint. When you have two or more creatures marked with a Speed Seal and you see one of them making an attack or casting a jutsu, you can spend your reaction targeting two marked creatures. Both creatures teleport, switching their current position on the map. This teleport happens before the jutsu’s effect takes place. If this teleport would take the jutsu or attack out of its range, the attacker/caster must choose a new valid target. If no creature is in the attacks/jutsu’s range, then the attack misses and the jutsu is Interrupted. Both Seals then are dispelled on both creatures.

Blink Burst. When a hostile creature marked with your Speed Seal would deal damage to you or inflict a Physical or Elemental condition as a result of an attack or jutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction, dispel the targets Speed Seal and spend 1 additional Speed Seal. When you do, make a Dexterity saving throw vs the triggering creatures attack result or their jutsu’s save DC. On a success, you avoid the attack or treat your success as if you succeeded their saving throw and they were forcing a Dexterity save. You also teleport into an adjacent space near them and can cast a Jutsu that requires an attack, has a casting time of 1 Action and only targets the triggering creature.

Sovereign of Speed

15th Level Clan Feature

You learn to vibrate your body accelerating yourself beyond normal shinobi limits. Infusing your cells themselves with the energy needed to ignore friction itself. As a bonus action, you can enter the Speed Sovereign state for the next minute. You can enter this state once per long rest.
